text: From S16 (not acted on): TrialScene lowered on a surface whose aspect differs from the gaze extent (900x700 in FigureGazeSuite) scales x and y differently (~5.6%), so the cross's vertical arm reads 21.12 native px against the frame's x-scale. Figures are isotropic. Check while doing S10 whether the real trial view always gets a surface at the extent's aspect, or whether TrialScene should letterbox to keep stimulus space isotropic.
